result.reason: The clause adopts New York law and facially provides for exclusive jurisdiction in New York County, but it retains language permitting confirmation of an arbitral award in any court of competent jurisdiction, including where the adverse party resides. That express alternative venue is inconsistent with the required exclusive New York County forum. Adding a New York arbitration seat also goes beyond the stated court-jurisdiction change while failing to reconcile the conflicting award-enforcement provision. The severability and underlying agreement to arbitrate are otherwise preserved.
